headline: Six Nordic Defense Contractors Alliance to Target Joint Procurement
summary: Six Nordic defense companies, including Saab and Patria, forged a strategic alliance focusing on space, maritime, and joint procurement. Patria reported a 39% increase in revenues this year.
why: Saab and Patria are major European defense manufacturers supplying military hardware, armored vehicles, and surveillance technology.

impacts.name: Saab AB
impacts.why: Cross-border defense alliances enable greater production scale and shared procurement opportunities across Nordic nations.
